verdict.rationale: Parsec is an account-based remote-desktop service with team configurations and audit logs, so data portability is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no feature for exporting all user data in open formats or for an exit path. Audit logs and reporting available through the Teams API are an adjacent developer building block, not a documented full-data export, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
